pattern: proxy finish LIGHT (proxy_finish.py stage_light + proxy_finish_light.py): the frozen Pixal3D sheet proxy kept as generated (geometry + texture), made watertight, decimated, baked, optionally reposed with bones

config.fit_side_length_why: unit note + proxy gate (sha 2387a65c): side length / front height 0.637 vs the sheet's 0.605 (+5.3 %): Y scaled x 0.950 to the sheet

refloor.why: sheet_proxy already floored the FEET: the lowest texels are the dark talons (L* 8..15) at x -0.19 / +0.53, y -0.85 / +0.22, z 0.000..0.006; the tail tip (pale, x 1.46 y 1.78) sits 0.06 u up. The window only confirms the foot contact and rescales x(7.17 / 7.102) = 1.0096 to the sheet front height (sheet front 7.17 vs side 7.16 u: the views agree, -0.1 %)

dense.why: the head: sorcerer hat (brim x -2.07..1.15, top z 7.17), pangolin snout, eyes (proxy slabs z 5.0..7.17 after the refloor, sha 2387a65c; landmark front_most y -2.26 x0.950 = -2.15 at z 5.5); vg_weight 0.3 so the eye box can sit denser

the two eyes under the brim (proxy vivid-blue texels b* < -55, L* > 48: x -1.12..-1.00 and -0.80..-0.72, y -1.18..-1.06, z 5.60..5.78; head turned to -x as generated) held denser so the glow lands on the eye faces, not the snout scales

light.ao_why: AO baked on the watertight low itself: the proxy's layered scale blades are inner shells that black-hole AO rays (storm_bear / vulture_creature lesson)
light.ao_distance_why: storm_bear lesson: about one scale-blade length keeps the real crevices (under the hat brim, arm pits, between the legs) without the broad darkening of the layered robe
light.ao_fill_why: AO texels under 0.04 (bake origins inside the scale soup) refilled from valid neighbours (storm_bear idiom)
light.bake_drop_interior_why: proxy faces with solid on both sides (inner scale shells) left out of the bake source so the cage stays tight
light.uv_island_margin_why: the scale-blade low unwraps into thousands of islands; the default margin starves the atlas (storm_bear / vulture_creature idiom)

recolour3d.name: tone_tips_white_blue
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (tone): the proxy texture reads darker / duller than the sheet's white-to-blue gradient: proxy texels L* p10/25/50/75/90 7/13/25/41/57 vs the sheet front + side masks 15/23/38/59/73. The sheet drift fit (light.colour_fit) refused itself (median residual 54.8 RGB > 35: the scale pattern does not register per pixel); run 1 (6 L* bands, one hue each) matched L* but flattened the hue spread (basecolor b* p10 -26.8 vs the sheet -38.9: the finish read silver-grey on the panel). Now a 2D QUANTILE map: 6 L* bands (brightest first, so a band's output sits above the next band's select) x 3 b* thirds per band (bluest first), each class to the sheet's colour at the same L* quantile band and the same b* third, the proxy's detail kept as a luma ratio. Crystals (b* < -52) and the eyes (box) keep their colour (glow below). Sim on 400k proxy samples (/1.08): L* p10/25/50/75/90 16.9/23.7/37.7/59.1/71.8 vs the sheet 14.8/22.9/37.9/58.9/73.4; b* p10/50/90 -38.3/-21.1/-0.1 vs -38.9/-19.7/-1.7; 7 % of texels caught by two classes (sim included). | class: proxy L* 55..100 (quantiles 87.9..100.0 % of the non-crystal texels), b* -52.0..-15.2 (this band's blue third; proxy median [139, 144, 194]) -> the sheet's same L* quantile band (front + side masks L* 71.5..98.9) and same b* third (b* -44.0..-8.9, median [179, 188, 225]), x1.08 for the AO multiply; gamma = the sheet / proxy log luma spread q10..q90

glow3d.name: eyes
glow3d.why: sheet: NARROW, INTENSE blue eye (front / side eye pixels b* < -30, brightest quarter 76..96,109..121,188..192, cores to 116..126,207..209,255): faces in the eye box whose baked albedo is the vivid eye blue (L* >= 45, b* <= -50: the proxy eye texels 81..86,109..114,222..237; run 1 at b* <= -40 lit 490 faces incl. the dark-blue brim underside 71,85,177 L* 40 b* -51) -> eye_glow

glow3d.name: crystal_core
glow3d.why: sheet: ARCANE CRYSTALS EMBEDDED (bright blue diamonds on chest, arms, robe, hat): the brightest crystal faces (baked L* >= 52, b* <= -48; run 1 at L* >= 58 / b* <= -45 caught 5 faces: the per-face UV-centroid albedo of an 18k low rarely lands on a core texel; sheet cores L* > 65 b* < -40 = 127,165,249, 0.5 % of the front + side masks) -> crystal_core

glow3d.name: crystal_body
glow3d.why: the rest of the crystal faces: vivid blue (baked b* <= -52 = the texels the tone map leaves as generated, L* >= 38: 2.1 % of the proxy samples vs the sheet b* < -55 share 2.0 %; run 1 at L* >= 44 / b* <= -55 lit only 151 faces) -> crystal_glow (sheet crystals b* < -55: median 63,99,218, 2.0 % of the front + side masks)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): Pixal3D copied the sheet's 3/4 FRONT by building the whole mage turned about Z. Measured on the v1 low (stage-1 frame): whole-low best mirror plane yaw -35 deg through x -0.14 (p99 0.927 at x 0 -> 0.534); head z > 5 best plane -40.5 deg (p99 0.267; face slabs -31..-39, hat slabs -43..-48); the two eye-glow clusters are a symmetric pair about the -40.5 head plane (lateral +0.147 / -0.132, depth -1.369 / -1.349, z 5.704 / 5.658), i.e. the face is TURNED, not sculpted crooked; a +35 deg turn puts the robe train on the midline (tail tip x 1.40 -> 0.23) and the planted +x foot pointing straight ahead. One rigid turn (no vertex moves relative to another); the repose below works in this turned frame

rig.spine_why: v2, turned frame (light.yaw +35): spine on the body plane x 0; the head bone (0, -0.55, 5.5) -> (-0.10, -1.60, 5.40) runs along the face's own forward axis (the head plane, 5.5 deg off -y after the root turn), so heading -y turns it exactly onto the midline

chains.name: arm
chains.why: v2, turned frame (arm-column medians |x| > 1.0 in 0.3 u slabs of the v1 low): points = the +x arm hanging at the side (column x 1.10..1.17, y -0.2..0.2 from z 4.4 down to the claws z 1.5), points_R = the -x arm as generated: carried forward (column y -0.6..-1.2 at z 2.6..4.4) with the hand raised (claws z 2.3..2.8); the repose makes the pair mirror-symmetric (mean)

chains.name: leg
chains.why: v2, turned frame (leg-column tracking, 0.15 u slabs, radius 0.4, + top-down slices of the v1 low): points = the +x leg, planted (column x 0.52..0.61, y 0.2..0.35 for z 0.2..1.6; talons forward to y -0.75 on z 0), points_R = the -x leg as generated: a stride, stepped forward and out with the foot lifted (ankle -0.77, -0.77, 0.45; toes splayed ~35 deg out to y -1.3, lowest z 0.1); the hips are set mirror-symmetric (moving the -x hip root tore the robe offline, stretch max 9.2)

chains.name: tail
chains.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: a tail chain that rests centred and can be posed to either side): a 4-bone TAIL CHAIN (tail.0..tail.3) through the long robe train (v1 tail points turned +35 deg: root (0, 0.85, 2.0) -> tip (0.23, 2.36, 0.1))

clips.why: PLACEHOLDER (movement + height are the open artist questions): idle = breathe + the kit's arm / tail sway; walk = a measured upright stride (leg_swing 8: the kit's foot bend dips the toes below the floor at larger swings, storm_bear / ember_rex lesson)

config._doc: LIGHT finish of the raw Pixal3D proxy (seed 56, sha 2387a65c). Points: stage-1 frame (fit_side_length Y x0.950, feet on the floor, x1.0096 to the sheet front height), sheet units. v2: light.yaw +35 (root turn) + repose (legs / arms / head / tail chain); rig, repose, focus in the turned frame.

targets.why: artist 2026-10-17: symmetric rest pose. The -x leg's stride (stepped forward ~0.9 u and out, foot lifted 0.1..0.45 u, toes splayed) is pose: both legs carried onto the planted +x leg (match L; a mean would leave both feet half-lifted mid-stride), both feet planted on z 0; falloff 0.06 (offline on the v1 low: 0.03 tore the robe blades at the -x hip, stretch max 9.2 -> 3.8)
the arms mirror-symmetric at the mean (the -x arm hung 0.35..1.0 u further forward with the hand 0.35..0.75 u higher); no plant, the claws hang free

targets.heading: -y
targets.why: the face straight ahead: after the root turn the head plane is still 5.5 deg off (head best plane -5.5 deg, x +0.04); the neck twists 2.7, the head 5.4; the head is RIGID (below). Offline: head best plane after -0.5 deg, x +0.02

targets.heading: +y
targets.why: the robe train / tail on the midline (heading +y = each tail bone yawed onto straight back), the chain rests centred and is posed to the side later

rigid.why: the whole head (sorcerer hat + brim + curled tip, pangolin snout, both eyes; z > 5.05 in the turned frame) moves as ONE rigid body with the head bone: never deformed or re-sculpted (face as generated)

repose.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17, 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): the proxy's root turn is undone as ONE rigid turn (light.yaw) and the stride / forward arm / head residual / swung train with BONES (proxy_finish_repose) in the turned frame, never by mirror-averaging geometry. v1 colours, glow, dense, AO are unchanged (stage-1 boxes)

config.focus_why: v2: focus boxes in the turned frame (light.yaw)

proxy.gate: proxy unreliable, work from the sheet (side length off by +5.3%)

side_length_fit.rule: the sheet is the spec: Y stretched to the sheet's side length

refloor.rule: sheet_proxy put the floor at the lowest point (a tail curl): the feet hung z0 above it; floor moved to the feet, then scaled to the sheet front height

solid.rule: LIGHT: watertight remesh only (no smoothing / straighten / symmetrise / cuts); the surface sits min_half_thickness x step = 0.0120 u outside the proxy

colour.mode: light: the proxy texture as generated

recolour3d.name: tone_tips_white_blue
recolour3d.why: UNIT NOTE (tone): the proxy texture reads darker / duller than the sheet's white-to-blue gradient: proxy texels L* p10/25/50/75/90 7/13/25/41/57 vs the sheet front + side masks 15/23/38/59/73. The sheet drift fit (light.colour_fit) refused itself (median residual 54.8 RGB > 35: the scale pattern does not register per pixel); run 1 (6 L* bands, one hue each) matched L* but flattened the hue spread (basecolor b* p10 -26.8 vs the sheet -38.9: the finish read silver-grey on the panel). Now a 2D QUANTILE map: 6 L* bands (brightest first, so a band's output sits above the next band's select) x 3 b* thirds per band (bluest first), each class to the sheet's colour at the same L* quantile band and the same b* third, the proxy's detail kept as a luma ratio. Crystals (b* < -52) and the eyes (box) keep their colour (glow below). Sim on 400k proxy samples (/1.08): L* p10/25/50/75/90 16.9/23.7/37.7/59.1/71.8 vs the sheet 14.8/22.9/37.9/58.9/73.4; b* p10/50/90 -38.3/-21.1/-0.1 vs -38.9/-19.7/-1.7; 7 % of texels caught by two classes (sim included). | class: proxy L* 55..100 (quantiles 87.9..100.0 % of the non-crystal texels), b* -52.0..-15.2 (this band's blue third; proxy median [139, 144, 194]) -> the sheet's same L* quantile band (front + side masks L* 71.5..98.9) and same b* third (b* -44.0..-8.9, median [179, 188, 225]), x1.08 for the AO multiply; gamma = the sheet / proxy log luma spread q10..q90

high.rule: marching tets of the whole remesh grid (no mirror)

low.method: collapse decimation: uniform to 300000, then 18000 with the dense boxes calibrated

dense.rule: dense boxes weighted 0.02 (vs 1) in the collapse decimation; the factor bisected until the boxes hold density x the rest's triangles per area

ao_fill.rule: AO < below = a bake origin inside the proxy soup: refilled from the covered valid 3x3 neighbours ring by ring (opt-in light.ao_fill_below)

bake.source: the proxy mesh itself (not the remesh)

rows.why: sheet: NARROW, INTENSE blue eye (front / side eye pixels b* < -30, brightest quarter 76..96,109..121,188..192, cores to 116..126,207..209,255): faces in the eye box whose baked albedo is the vivid eye blue (L* >= 45, b* <= -50: the proxy eye texels 81..86,109..114,222..237; run 1 at b* <= -40 lit 490 faces incl. the dark-blue brim underside 71,85,177 L* 40 b* -51) -> eye_glow

sheet: ARCANE CRYSTALS EMBEDDED (bright blue diamonds on chest, arms, robe, hat): the brightest crystal faces (baked L* >= 52, b* <= -48; run 1 at L* >= 58 / b* <= -45 caught 5 faces: the per-face UV-centroid albedo of an 18k low rarely lands on a core texel; sheet cores L* > 65 b* < -40 = 127,165,249, 0.5 % of the front + side masks) -> crystal_core

the rest of the crystal faces: vivid blue (baked b* <= -52 = the texels the tone map leaves as generated, L* >= 38: 2.1 % of the proxy samples vs the sheet b* < -55 share 2.0 %; run 1 at L* >= 44 / b* <= -55 lit only 151 faces) -> crystal_glow (sheet crystals b* < -55: median 63,99,218, 2.0 % of the front + side masks)

glow3d.rule: faces -> glow palette regions (emission -> Glow -> Emission Color); rgb white keeps the baked albedo

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

yaw.why: v2 (artist 2026-10-17: 'our characters should be symmetrical head turns are done through posing so our models remain flexible'): Pixal3D copied the sheet's 3/4 FRONT by building the whole mage turned about Z. Measured on the v1 low (stage-1 frame): whole-low best mirror plane yaw -35 deg through x -0.14 (p99 0.927 at x 0 -> 0.534); head z > 5 best plane -40.5 deg (p99 0.267; face slabs -31..-39, hat slabs -43..-48); the two eye-glow clusters are a symmetric pair about the -40.5 head plane (lateral +0.147 / -0.132, depth -1.369 / -1.349, z 5.704 / 5.658), i.e. the face is TURNED, not sculpted crooked; a +35 deg turn puts the robe train on the midline (tail tip x 1.40 -> 0.23) and the planted +x foot pointing straight ahead. One rigid turn (no vertex moves relative to another); the repose below works in this turned frame
yaw.rule: p' = Rz(deg) (p - about) + to on every vertex of the finished low (one rigid turn about Z, the root orientation; no vertex moves relative to another)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

stretch_all.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

repose.rule: LBS with the contract rig's weights (+ rigid pins), yaw-only straightening (+ lift), applied as rest

stretch_leg.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_arm.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_neck_head.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

stretch_tail.rule: edge length after / before the repose, edges with a moved vertex

self_intersections.rule: intersecting triangle pairs sharing no vertex (BVH overlap)

mirror_before.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

mirror_after.rule: every vertex mirrored in X about the plane -> distance to the nearest surface (0 = exactly symmetric)

floor.rule: stage 1 floored the FEET at z 0; the centring puts the lowest point at 0

facing.rule: shell centroid -> the front-most midline point of the shell (proxy finish default)
